name: Kuhli Loach (Pangio kuhlii)
description: Eel-shaped Southeast Asian loach that lives between hardscape crevices and emerges at dusk. Substring 'kuhli' fires both the bottom depth-band and the timid curiosity heuristic (boldness 0.05, ratePerSec 0.005). Needs soft substrate and dense hardscape cover or it hides constantly out of sight.
